sanskrit: ṛṇād ṛṇam iva saṃ naya kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛto gṛham | cakṣurmantrasya durhārdaḥ pṛṣṭīr api śṛṇāñjana ||
english: As one debt is discharged by another debt, carry the sorcery back to the house of its maker. O collyrium, O evil-hearted one of the eye-spell, shatter even the ribs.

sanskrit: yad asmāsu duṣvapnyaṃ yad goṣu yac ca no gṛhe | amāmagatyasta durhārdaḥ priya prati muñcatām ||
english: Whatever ill-omen of evil dreams rests upon us, upon our cattle, or within our house — let that evil-hearted one who has gone home to his mother release it back to the dear one who sent it.

sanskrit: apām ūrja ojaso vāvṛdhānam agner jātam adhi jātavedasaḥ | caturvīraṃ parvatīyaṃ yad āñjanaṃ diśaḥ pradiśaḥ karad ic chivās te ||
english: This mountain-born collyrium, grown mighty with the vigour and vitality of the waters, born from Agni upon Jātavedas — four-hero-bestowing — let it make all the directions and the sub-directions auspicious for you.

sanskrit: caturvīraṃ badhyata āñjanaṃ te sarvā diśo abhayās te bhavantu | dhruvas tiṣṭhādhi saviteva vārya imā viśo abhi harantu te balim ||
english: The collyrium that bestows four heroes is bound upon you; may all the directions be free from fear for you. Stand firm as the desirable Savitṛ stands; let these peoples bring tribute to you.

sanskrit: āṅkṣvaikaṃ maṇim ekaṃ kṛṇuṣva snāhy ekena pibaikam eṣām | caturvīraṃ nairṛtebhyaś caturbhyo grāhyā bandhebhyaḥ pari pātv asmān ||
english: Apply one, fashion one amulet, bathe with one, drink one of them. May the four-hero-granting collyrium guard us from the four Nirṛtis, from the bonds of seizure.

sanskrit: agnir māghnyenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
english: May Agni guard him with the means sacred to Agni — for breath and outbreath, for life-span, for radiance, for vital force, for brilliance, for well-being, for good estate. Svāhā.

sanskrit: indro mendryeṇāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
english: May Indra guard me with the means sacred to Indra — for breath and outbreath, for life-span, for radiance, for vital force, for brilliance, for well-being, for good estate. Svāhā.

sanskrit: somo mā somyenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
english: May Soma guard me with the means sacred to Soma — for breath and outbreath, for life-span, for radiance, for vital force, for brilliance, for well-being, for good estate. Svāhā.

sanskrit: bhago mā bhagenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
english: May Bhaga guard me with the means sacred to Bhaga — for breath and outbreath, for life-span, for radiance, for vital force, for brilliance, for well-being, for good estate. Svāhā.

sanskrit: maruto mā gaṇair avantu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
english: May the Maruts guard me with their hosts — for breath and outbreath, for life-span, for radiance, for vital force, for brilliance, for well-being, for good estate. Svāhā.

sanskrit: āyurdā deva jarasaṃ pṛṇāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtapṛṣṭho agne | ghṛtaṃ pibann amṛtaṃ cāru gavyaṃ piteva putraṃ jarase nayemam ||
english: O Agni, O god, giver of life-span, filling him with old age, ghee-faced and ghee-backed — drinking ghee and the lovely immortal essence of the cow, lead this man to old age as a father leads his son.

sanskrit: āyur asmai dhehi jātavedaḥ prajāṃ tvaṣṭar adhi ni dhehy onaḥ | rāyaspoṣaṃ savitar ā suvāsmai śataṃ jīvāti śaradas tavāyam ||
english: Bestow long life upon him, O Jātavedas; firmly place offspring in him, O Tvaṣṭṛ, from on high. Grant him the full swelling of riches, O Savitṛ — may this man of yours live a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: imam agna āyuṣe varcase dhāḥ priyaṃ reto varuṇa mitra rājan | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭir jathāsat ||
english: Establish this man in life-span and radiance, O Agni; make his seed dear, O Varuṇa, O King Mitra. Grant him shelter as a mother, O Aditi; may he be vigorous unto old age, O All-Gods.

sanskrit: agniṣ ṭa āyuḥ prataraṃ kṛṇotu somas te puṣṭiṃ prataraṃ dadhātu | indro marutvān adhi te bravītv ādityais te aditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||
english: May Agni further extend your life-span; may Soma further establish your nourishment. May Indra with the Maruts speak on your behalf; may Aditi together with the Ādityas grant you shelter.

sanskrit: revatīs tvā vyakṣaṇaṃ kṛttikāś cakṛtus tvā | apasas tvām atanvata dhiyo 'vayann avāgnāyīr apṛñcan ||
english: The Revatī stars fashioned your pervasion; the Kṛttikās shaped you. The active ones stretched you out; the prayers, the Avāgnāyī constellations, commingled you in weaving.

sanskrit: sahasram antām̐ abhito 'dadantā- -aśītir madhyam abhayaṃ vi nārīḥ | devīr devāya paridhe savitre mahat tad āsāmaghavan mahitvam ||
english: A thousand threads they set along the borders; eighty threads the women spread in the middle, fearless. O divine women, for the deity Savitṛ as a garment — great indeed was the greatness of these goddesses.

sanskrit: imam aśmānam ā tiṣṭha- -aśmeva tvaṃ sthiro bhava | pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ sahasva pṛtaṇāyataḥ ||
english: Stand upon this stone; become firm as stone itself. Crush down those who wish harm; overpower those who array their forces against you.

sanskrit: yena devaṃ savitāraṃ pari devā adhārayan | tenemaṃ brahmaṇaspate pari rāṣṭrāya dhattana ||
english: With that by which the gods encompassed the divine Savitṛ — with that same means, O Bṛhaspati, encompass and establish this man for sovereignty.

sanskrit: parīmam indram āyuṣe mahe kṣatrāya dhattana | yathainaṃ jarase nayāñ jyok kṣatre adhi jāgarat ||
english: Encompass this Indra and establish him for long life and great sovereignty — so that you may lead him to old age; long may he remain wakeful in sovereignty.

sanskrit: parīmaṃ somam āyuṣe mahe śrotrāya dhattana | yathainaṃ jarase nayāṃ jyok śrotre adhi jāgarat ||
english: Encompass this Soma and establish him for long life and great hearing — so that you may lead him to old age; long may he remain wakeful in hearing.

sanskrit: pari dhatta dhatta varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrgham āyuḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u ||
english: Invest him, invest him with radiance; make death come only at old age, extend his life-span long. Bṛhaspati gave forth this garment to be put on by King Soma.

sanskrit: jarāṃ su gaccha pari dhatsva vāso bhavā gṛṣṭīnām abhiśastivā u | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā rāyaspoṣam upa saṃ vyayasva ||
english: Go well to old age; put on the garment; be one who overcomes the curse of the young cows. Live a hundred autumns, brilliant in radiance; clothe yourself in the full swelling of riches.

sanskrit: parīdaṃ vāso api dhāḥ svastaye 'bhūr vāpīnām abhiśastipā u | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīr vasūni cārur vibhajāsi jīvan ||
english: Put on this garment all around for well-being; become one who protects against the curse of the sowers. Live a hundred autumns in fullness; lovely and living, may you distribute riches abundantly.

sanskrit: yoge yoge tapastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indram ūtaye ||
english: At every yoking we invoke the most fervent Indra; at every contest, as friends, we call him for aid.

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarṇo ajaraḥ suvīro jarāmṛtyuḥ prajayā saṃ viśasva | tad agnir āha tad u soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tad indraḥ ||
english: Golden-hued, unaging, rich in heroes, dying only at old age — enter into your offspring thus. So has Agni declared; so too has Soma declared; so Bṛhaspati, Savitṛ, and Indra.

sanskrit: yadottamat tantu badhāya nāvadvāsaḥ pūrvayāvat pururūpapeśaḥ | bhadrātīkā samajaraṃ suvīraṃ tena devāḥ pra tirantv āyuḥ ||
english: With this uppermost thread, the new garment fit for tying — preceding in course, manifold in form and ornament, with auspicious aspect, coeval in aging, rich in heroes — with this may the gods extend his life-span.

sanskrit: yasya brāhmaṇaḥ sicam ārabhante śrathnanto nīvaṃ pratiranta āyuḥ | tasya devā devahūtiṃ juṣantāṃ sa viśvahā sacatāṃ svasti ||
english: He whose skirt the Brāhmaṇas take hold of — loosening the waistband, extending his life-span — may the gods delight in that man's invocation of the gods; may well-being attend him always.

sanskrit: anyad ā dhatsva pari dhatsva vāsa imam ulbam apa lumpāmi yas te | jarase tvām ṛṣayaḥ saṃ vyayantu sūryo bhagas te pra tirantv āyuḥ ||
english: Take up a different garment; clothe yourself in it — I cut away this caul that clings to you. May the seers clothe you for old age; may Sūrya and Bhaga extend your life-span.

sanskrit: yasya devāsaḥ prathamavāsyaṃ harāmi taṃ tvā viśve avantu devāḥ | taṃ tvā bhrātaraḥ suvṛdhā vardhamānam anu jāyantāṃ bahavaḥ sujātam ||
english: Him whose first garment I remove — may all the gods protect you, that one. May many brothers, well-grown, growing in prosperity, be born after you, O well-born one.

sanskrit: ahatenāhato bhava sthira sthireṇa saṃ bhava | pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ ||
english: Unsmit, be unsmit; firm, unite with firmness. Crush down those who wish harm; overpower those who array their forces against you.
